items.title: Brush teeth for 1 minute
items.why: Daily brushing slows tartar buildup, which can push back the need for a dental cleaning.

items.title: Wash the bowl and refill fresh water
items.why: Clean water every day supports kidney and urinary health.

items.title: Take a 20-minute walk
items.why: Regular exercise keeps weight in check, and a healthy weight lowers vet costs over a lifetime.

items.title: Play for 10 minutes
items.why: Active play keeps indoor cats at a healthy weight.

items.title: Check the coat for fleas and ticks
items.why: Catching fleas early is cheaper than treating an infestation in your home.

items.title: Check and trim nails
items.why: Trimming at home saves a grooming visit and prevents painful splits.
